source_caption:
🎬 Avengement (2019) — Action, Crime, Thriller
Cain Burgess is a hardened criminal who escapes from prison with one goal: to find the people responsible for destroying his life. After years of suffering behind bars, Cain returns to the criminal world carrying anger, pain, and a desire for revenge.
As he tracks down the people connected to his past, Cain confronts dangerous criminals and forces them to answer for what happened to him. But his journey is not simply about revenge—it is also about uncovering the betrayal that put him on the path he is now desperately trying to escape.
The movie explores revenge, betrayal, guilt, violence, and the consequences of a life shaped by crime. Cain's brutal actions reveal how years of pain can transform someone, while also raising the question of whether revenge can ever truly repair what was taken away.
More than just an action movie, Avengement is a dark story about a man consumed by the consequences of betrayal and his desperate attempt to settle the score. 🔥
💬 If someone destroyed your life and justice failed you, would you choose revenge or try to walk away? 👇

source_details.title: Avengement
source_details.synopsis: Avengement is a 2019 British action thriller film directed by Jesse V. Johnson who co-wrote the film with Stu Small. The film stars Scott Adkins, Craig Fairbrass and Thomas Turgoose. Avengement was released on 24 May 2019 on VOD and in selected theatres, where it received generally positive reviews from critics with praise for its action choreography and Adkins' performance. In 2020, a special edition was released, which contains an uncut version of the film.
